coverage_assessment: First pass captured 44 web-search invocations and 1063 returned headers, producing 62 source cards. Portuguese-language searches covered federal-worker wage actions, fare policy and transit, municipal health/labor, education/students, public health restrictions, social justice and cultural policy, with national, regional and city leads. Three candidates are retained: two proposed inclusions (Brasília Jan. 18; Rio Jan. 25) and one search-only Jan. 19 São Paulo candidate pending evidence. Coverage remains open: no LexisNexis/paid-hemeroteca pass, the official baseline/codebook is pending, and several local/secondary records have no body or turnout evidence.
